data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 迎宾舞厅的红酒祝酒回眸
data.description: 政商名流云集的迎宾宴会厅，金碧辉煌的宫殿穹顶下乐声悠扬。晴奈换上一袭深蓝近夜色、带金色牡丹刺绣的高叉露背旗袍，美背白皙耀目，曲线高挑迷人。她单手举起盛着醇厚红酒的高脚杯向身侧的老师侧身祝酒，猩红美眸中闪烁着致命的诱惑与心动。
data.action: raising red wine glass in elegant toast, turning back, showing backless cut, charming smile
data.lighting: dazzling golden palace chandeliers casting rich warm highlights
data.mood: dazzling high-society glamour, seductive royalty, and captivating grace
data.promptProse: Inside a grand golden banquet hall, Kurodate Haruna turns gracefully in her backless midnight-blue silk dress, raising a crystal wine glass with an intoxicating gaze.
data.animaCaption: Haruna turning gracefully with a raised wine glass under grand chandeliers.
